name: Modules.Nfc.TagTechnologyNdefFormatable
summary: Provide access to NDEF format operations on a [Modules.Nfc.NfcTag](api:Modules.Nfc.NfcTag).
description:
Use the [Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyNdefFormatable](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyNdefFormatable) method to create this tag technology.

See also:
[NdefFormatable](http://developer.android.com/reference/android/nfc/tech/NdefFormatable.html)

methods.name: format
methods.summary: Format a tag as NDEF, and write a [Modules.Nfc.NdefMessage](api:Modules.Nfc.NdefMessage).

parameters.name: message
parameters.summary: The NDEF message to write after formatting, can be null.

methods.name: formatReadOnly
methods.summary: Formats a tag as NDEF, write a [Modules.Nfc.NdefMessage](api:Modules.Nfc.NdefMessage), and make read-only.

parameters.name: message
parameters.summary: The NDEF message to write after formatting
